messages:
maya_pm: Draft PRD uploaded — H‑Med (pilot) asks for private deployment with HIPAA controls + per-tenant model pinning. Need alignment on scope, acceptance criteria, and canary/A-B plan. Link: https://redwood/drive/prd-hmed
alex: quick read. My instinct: prioritize safety & rollback over micro-optimizing latency for v1. We can gradually improve perf in Dedicated.
jordan_eng: couple things: are we committing to 16-bit quantized weights? target hardware? T4s will hit higher p95. Also model pin TTL — should have automatic expiry or owner approval.
sara_research: put together suggested metrics + acceptance criteria. Sharing minimal eval checklist:
```
Acceptance criteria:
- p95 latency <= 200ms for 512 tokens (goal 150ms) on Dedicated A100
- Availability >= 99.5% during canary
- Error rate (5xx) < 0.5%
- Quality regression: embedding sim >= baseline - 1.5% on eval set
- No sensitive data leakage in 500 randomized PHI probes
- Per-tenant pinning: support pin+expiry + audit log
- Rollout MUST include automatic fallback to model-variant if quality regresses
```
ben_sre: rollout/rollback mechanics from infra POV:
- Start canary @0.5% -> 2% -> 10% -> 25% -> 100% (each step 30m-1h)
- Abort conditions: p95 > threshold OR errors up >0.8% OR quality regression detected
- Immediate rollback: re-route traffic to previous model version, disable pinning persistence, trigger incident channel
- Postmortem automation: snapshot logs + perf traces
maya_pm: who owns the canary gating? need a single on-call to press abort and a chart with these three signals: latency/error/quality. @jordan_eng @ben_sre
jordan_eng: i'll own gating & make a small dashboard. Will add instrumentation for token-level cost and per-request quality score. Plan to surface signal to #prod-monitoring.
ben_sre: i'll add alerting + automated rollback playbook. Also want a 'soft-fail' fallback: if KV cache thrashes, degrade to lower-throughput model variant rather than full rollback.
alex: customer asks for per-tenant version pinning. proposal: allow tenant pin with TTL=72h and manual renew; automatic expiry sends email + console alert. Emergency pin override for security incidents.
maya_pm: agree. add acceptance criteria for pin behaviour and auditability.
sara_research: also note edge cases: mixed-tenancy requests (shared resources), long-running conversational KV cache size, and token counter drift when migrating models. Add tests for those.
ben_sre: short checklist for launch-day runbook:
```
- Canary start time + owner
- Dashboard url
- Abort criteria
- Rollback command (infra CLI)
- Post-rollback verification steps
```
maya_pm: action items: jordan -> dashboard + instrumentation (EOD Thu), ben -> rollback automation + alerts (Fri), sara -> expand eval harness with PHI probes (Mon), alex -> own customer comms + pin UX flow (Mon).
deploy-bot: canary scheduled: 2026-03-22T16:00Z (0.5% traffic) by @jordan_eng
maya_pm: thanks — let's sync Wed 10am PT to sign off on the PRD and runway for the pilot. :thumbsup:
